name: history-philosophy-science
description: The history and philosophy of science as a meta-discipline. Covers scientific paradigms and paradigm shifts, the nature of scientific theories versus hypotheses and laws, landmark discoveries as case studies in methodology, creativity and serendipity in science, the social and cultural context of scientific practice, and science-society relationships. Use when teaching, discussing, or evaluating the nature of science, its history, or its place in society.
